text:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — I'm swapping weekend oncall with @Maya for this coming Sat/Sun. Also planning a small alert routing tweak for noisy CPU spikes overnight (details below).

Maya Singh: Thanks — sgtm. Do you want me to update the PD schedule or the Alertmanager rule?

Alex Chen: I'll change Alertmanager routing only, leave PD as-is. Plan: route alerts where alertname =~ "CPUSpike" and severity=critical to #eng-oncall between 00:00-08:00 UTC on Sat/Sun. Also raising the threshold so we get fewer pages (move from 90% -> 95%).

Samir Patel: Fine with the routing. Please add the runbook link to the alert so responders have the quick steps: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cpu-spike :eyes:

Kyra Lopez: Heads-up — Dedicated customers run heavy nightly batches. Raising threshold to 95% might hide customer-facing issues. Can we add an additional matcher to only route when job_name != "nightly-batch" or add a suppressed label?

Alex Chen: Good call. I'll add a negative matcher for job_name=nightly-batch and also attach a suppression label so we can silence non-actionable noise. New route snippet I'm going to apply: 

```yaml
route:
  match_re:
    alertname: ".*CPUSpike.*"
  match:
    severity: "critical"
  continue: false
  receiver: "eng-oncall-pager"
  routes:
    - matchers: ["job_name!=nightly-batch"]
      active_time: "00:00-08:00"
      weekdays: ["sat","sun"]
      labels:
        routing_note: "weekend-night-cpu"
      repeat_interval: "1h"
```

Alex Chen: And I'll set the threshold in the metric rule to 95% to reduce noisy paging. Will create a rollback snippet in case we get false negatives.

oncall-bot: Schedule swap confirmed — Alex Chen -> Maya Singh for 2026-03-21 00:00 UTC to 2026-03-22 00:00 UTC.

Maya Singh: I'll monitor the first night and update the runbook to reference the routing change. Will ping if we see missed customer impact. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: I pushed a small Grafana alert panel tweak and linked the alert to the dashboard (commit abc123). I'll keep an eye on the graphs 23:00-03:00 UTC.

Kyra Lopez: Thanks — please also add a short note in the ticket about Dedicated customer windows so we can revisit thresholds after Monday.

Alex Chen: Will file ops ticket now with links to Alertmanager PR + Grafana commit + runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/TSK-4123. Also tagging infra for visibility.

Maya Singh: Sounds good. Thanks everyone — I'll take the handoff at 00:00 UTC.

Alex Chen: Thanks, Maya. If anything unexpected, DM me or escalate to infra. :pray:
